D002: Inattention is caused by external stimuli and interest/curiosity in new activities. Restlessness is unrelated to worry or rumination.
D011: Inattention occurs due to worry or rumination associated with anxiety symptoms.

D002.key_difference: Onset of concentration problems and relationship with depressive symptoms

D002: Mood symptoms may appear but are distinct from a depressive episode; concentration problems appear continuously unrelated to depressive symptoms.
D013: Concentration problems occur exclusively during the major depressive episode.

D002.key_difference: Onset of inattention and relationship with psychotic symptoms

D002: Psychotic symptoms may co-occur, but inattention appears continuously from before, unrelated to psychotic symptoms.
D005: Inattention is observed starting from the prodromal phase or after the onset of psychotic symptoms.
